# Code of Conduct

TenantFlow adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/)
as its code of conduct. Its full text is the standard for everyone who takes part in this project: maintainers,
contributors and users. This applies in issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews, and anywhere else people
represent the project.

## In short

- Be respectful and welcoming, whatever someone's background, identity or experience level.
- Give and accept constructive feedback gracefully. Critique code and ideas, never people.
- Assume good intent, and ask before you conclude.
- No harassment, insults, personal or political attacks, sexualised language or imagery, trolling, or publishing
  anyone's private information without their explicit permission.

## Reporting

If you experience or see behaviour that breaks this code, report it privately to the maintainer:

- Use the **"Report content"** option on the comment, issue or pull request in GitHub, or
- contact the maintainer through their GitHub profile.

Reports are handled confidentially. The maintainer reviews every report and decides on a response, following the
Contributor Covenant's enforcement guidelines: a correction, a warning, a temporary ban, or a permanent ban.

## Attribution

This code of conduct adopts the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
